name: examples-capability
description: Three small synthetic tasks written for this repository (MIT): a dependency API migration, a path traversal fix and an extract-function refactor. Stdlib only, offline.

tasks.prompt: The vendored library under vendor/tinytable was upgraded to 2.0 and inventory.py no longer works with it. Read vendor/tinytable/CHANGELOG.md and migrate inventory.py to the new API without changing the text it produces. Do not edit anything under vendor/. Do not ask questions.

archive_tools/extract.py unpacks uploaded zip archives, but a crafted archive can make it write files outside the destination directory (CWE-22, "zip slip"). Fix extract_all so that, when any member would be written outside dest, it raises UnsafeArchiveError before writing anything, and archives with safe members still extract as before. Do not ask questions.

render_invoice in invoice.py mixes the invoice layout with the discount rules. Extract the discount calculation into a module-level function discount_amount(subtotal: Decimal, code: str | None) -> Decimal that returns the amount to take off, and make render_invoice call it. The output of render_invoice must not change; the tests in tests/ must keep passing. Do not ask questions.
